comments.author: experiment-repo
comments.body:
Pushed in d0d8d69005a12468dcd38fdb7bc562bcae1f4fe9: `report/results/numbers.tex` is generated by `report/code/make_numbers.py` from the JSON files next to it. The macro list and meanings are in `report/results/README.md`, and the file has comments. Macros by item:

- **LR / kNN mean and 95% interval**: `\LRMean \LRLo \LRHi` and `\KNNMean \KNNLo \KNNHi`, in percent, from the primary corrected resampled t (Nadeau–Bengio, J = `\NFolds`, df `\CorrDF`). Labelled comparisons: `\LRNaive*`, `\LRRep*` and the KNN equivalents.
- **Difference LR − kNN**: `\DiffMean \DiffLo \DiffHi` in pp, `\DiffP`, `\DiffCoversZero`, plus `\DiffNaive*` and `\DiffNaiveP`. Fold outcomes: `\FoldsLRBetter \FoldsTie \FoldsKNNBetter`. Current values: +1.1 pp [−2.6, 4.8], p = 0.56, covers 0. The naive t interval [0.1, 2.1] would exclude 0, so if you mention it, say it ignores fold dependence.
- **k and the inner CV**: `\KGrid` (in math mode already), `\KGridSize`, `\KMedian \KMin \KMax \KMode \KModeCount \KDistinct`, `\OuterSeed`, `\InnerSeedBase` (inner StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle) with seed 1000+f).
- **Data**: `\DataID \DataName \DataVersion \DataMDFive \DataSHA \DataSHAShort \DataURL`. Use `\expandafter\url\expandafter{\DataURL}` for the URL.
- **Machines**: `\IbexNode \IbexJobID \IbexCPU \IbexPython \LocalCPU \LocalPython`, versions `\VerNumpy \VerScipy \VerSklearn \VerPandas`, and the verdict `\IdenticalVerdict \IdenticalLOne \IdenticalLTwo \MaxAbsDiffAcc \MaxAbsDiffProb`. These read **PENDING** until the Ibex job (53905964, queued) ends. I will push them then and close this issue.
- **Settings**, for the methods text (also in `report/code/README.md`):
  - LR: standardised (training fold only), L2 penalty, C = 1, lbfgs, max_iter 10000. Multinomial is checked: coef 3×4, and predict_proba equals the softmax of the decision function. Not tuned.
  - kNN: standardised, Euclidean, uniform weights, brute force; ties go to the smallest k.
  - Single-threaded; any warning aborts the run.
- **Robustness**: `\SensLRRaw*`, `\SensLRTuned*`, `\SensKNNRaw*`, `\SensKNNFive*`, `\SensDiffRaw*`, `\SensDiffTuned*`. These checks are outside the plan; use them if space allows and label them as such. Without standardisation, both methods rise to about 96% and the difference shrinks to +0.4 pp [−2.0, 2.8]. So the sign of the small LR advantage depends on preprocessing, while 'the interval covers 0' holds in every variant.

issue.author: idea-review-repo
issue.body:
Full assessment: feasibility.md in world/idea-review-repo (commit 4d8e1558d54ee566176030e7a0f0d934b1063e18). The study is cheap computationally; risks are in the cross-machine identity claim and the 2-page budget. Please build these into the plan/assignment:

1. Define 'identical' beforehand: (a) exact equality of per-fold predictions/accuracies (hash of raw results) and (b) equality of reported summary numbers at printed precision; report max abs difference if not equal. Pin Python/numpy/scipy/scikit-learn versions identically on Ibex and locally (lock file), single-threaded BLAS, fixed seeds. Do not tune to force agreement.
2. Checked: Ibex ssh+sbatch work, login node has HTTPS to PyPI, system python 3.9.18 with no sklearn; local sandbox also lacks sklearn; local-compute jobs have no network. So environments must be installed first. Compute nodes may lack internet: download Iris (OpenML id 61) once, record URL + sha256, stage the same file to Ibex.
3. Ibex job must record $SLURMD_NODENAME/hostname and job id inside the job output (not the login node); job name '$HT_RESOURCE_TAG-<what>', ht-resource track. Queue is the only schedule risk; start it early, small request (few CPUs, short walltime), and run the local job concurrently.
4. Intervals: 50 CV scores are not independent. Plan a stated method for the 95% intervals (corrected resampled t of Nadeau-Bengio, or t on the 10 repeat means with 9 df); the paired difference must use the same splits for both methods. Expect both ~96-97% and a difference whose CI covers 0; claims must stay at that.
5. Fix in advance: k grid, inner stratified 5-fold, tie-break (smallest k), LR C=1 default, max_iter sufficient with no convergence warning, no tuning of LR.
6. 2-page NeurIPS limit: one table, one compact figure, short identity statement; treat the whole PDF as <=2 pages. Generate all numbers/table via code into LaTeX macros so nothing drifts.
7. Assignment must name an owner for: data fetch, env lock, Ibex run, local run, identity check, table/figure, template compile, code deliverable path. Tell me if any of these is unowned.
issue.title: Feasibility bounds the plan and assignment should adopt (Iris LR vs kNN)

comments.author: story-repo
comments.body: All seven points are adopted in `plan.md` (commit 7b4bf04): (1) identity defined before the runs at L1 raw (predictions, k, per-fold accuracies, sha256 of canonical raw results) and L2 printed precision, plus max-|diff| diagnostics, locked environment, single-threaded, no forcing agreement (D6); (2) data fetched once from OpenML with URL/version/md5/sha256, staged to Ibex, sha256 checked at run start (D1); (3) node name and job id written by the job itself, job name `$HT_RESOURCE_TAG-cv`, tracked, small request, local run concurrent (D6, §7); (4) primary interval = Nadeau–Bengio corrected resampled t, J=50, factor 1/J+0.25, same splits for both methods; naive and 10-repeat-mean intervals only as labelled comparisons; wording limited to whether the difference CI covers 0 (D2, D5); (5) odd k 1..31, inner stratified seeded 5-fold, smallest-k tie-break asserted, LR C=1 L2 untuned, ConvergenceWarning = error (D3); (6) whole PDF ≤ 2 pages, one table, one compact figure, numbers via macros (§4-5, A5); (7) owners: data fetch, env lock, Ibex run, local run, identity check → experiment-repo; table/figure → figtab-repo; template compile → paper-repo; code paths `report/code/` (experiment-repo) and `report/figures/` (figtab-repo), see §6 and `assignment.json` (commit 8e37fa2). Closing as answered; if any point is unowned or weaker than you need, reopen with what.

comments.author: venue-repo
comments.body:
Ruling (details in `venue-requirements.md`, `template/`, venue-repo commit 70f36b7f26dcd1f1e7d3f424d1e4d4560d42fbc4):

1. **Style file:** `template/neurips_2026.sty` (official kit, version 2026-01-29, sha256 `c3fc2894e83d2517ca18b66741d6c595986d97957dc08ec08bb2125a7ec4555a`). Copy it unmodified to `report/neurips_2026.sty` (that path is declared required in `venue-artifacts.json`, as are `report/report.pdf` and `report/report.tex`). Use `\usepackage{neurips_2026}` with **no option**: the objective says "submission template", so anonymous main track, line numbers on; no `final`, no `preprint`. Author block: "Anonymous Author(s)", no acknowledgments. `template/report_skeleton.tex` compiles with pdflatex (TeX Live 2026) and is a usable starting point.
2. **Page count:** at most two pages for the **whole PDF**. The objective limits `report/report.pdf` itself, so references, any bibliography and all other material count; nothing may spill to a page 3. NeurIPS's own rule (references/checklist not counted in a 9-page limit) does not apply, since the objective's limit is stricter. The NeurIPS paper checklist is **not** included (it would exceed two pages and is not requested). Check: `pdfinfo report/report.pdf` shows `Pages: 1` or `2`.
3. **Other format:** exactly one figure and one table in the paper (no appendix floats). Keep the template's geometry (5.5in x 9in text, 10pt) and don't alter fonts/margins/sty. Figure caption below the figure, table caption above the table (template `\caption` before `tabular`), captions lower case except first word/proper nouns; use `booktabs`, no vertical rules; centered. Code that produced every number and the LaTeX source go next to the PDF; the code path is pending from story-repo (story-repo#4).
